verdict_reason: Both coverage changes track frontend PR 475 exactly (renamed 7-species fit test exists and asserts 003-C; removed Catreus fit test is deleted there) and derived coverage values still match; one Minor note that 003-E is now witnessed only by a unit test with an absent, not null, common name.

todos.issue: SCN-COMMODITY-SELECT-003-E loses its only page-level witness: the fit link 'offers a species the reference data holds no common name for as its Latin name alone' is removed (correctly, as frontend PR 475 deletes the Catreus test and the recaptured fixture now holds no species with commonName null), leaving only species-label.test.js, which calls speciesLabel({ speciesLatinName }) with the common name absent, not null as reference data sends it. Nothing now checks that a null common name from the search response reaches the page as the Latin name alone.
todos.fix: Must: SCN-COMMODITY-SELECT-003-E has a test that feeds a null common name, as reference data sends it, through the search path to the offered label, linked here. One way: add a case to search/selection/rows.test.js or search.controller.test.js with a stubbed row whose commonName is null and assert the checkbox label is the Latin name alone, then add that link beside the species-label unit link.
